infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the power substation adjacent to the Ultra shopping mall on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Power substation utility cabin key (Power) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the power substation utility cabin adjacent to the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Wooden crate
- 1x Weapon box (4x4)
- 1x MP-153 spawn
